{{Quote|The Republic's Great Manifest period (20,000&ndash;17,000 BBY) marked an increased movement into the Rimward territories of the Slice, which became known as the Expansion Region.|From the text of ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
The year '''20,000 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' marked the end of the [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] and the beginning of the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Now approximately five thousand years old, the Republic began a period of rapid expansion out from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and into the areas of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] "east" of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] center. Other cultures, such as the [[Etti]], had already begun Rimward migration. Further development and exploration took place in the Core as well. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], suffering from a lack of trade and overpopulation, began its attempt to blaze a [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|new hyperlane]] connecting it to both [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and points westward to alleviate these issues. Once completed, the route stretched from Coruscant to [[Orooturoo]].

==Proem==
The [[Expansionist Period/Legends|Expansionist Era]] had marked a steady but limited growth to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Most [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] settlement was confined to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and the Republic worlds that mostly lined the existing [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]]. Exploration into the regions colloquially known as "[[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]" and blazing new hyperspace routes were regarded as incredibly dangerous.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><br /> Nevertheless, the [[Etti]] had already begun migrating out of the Core Worlds as a response to persecution at the hands of the Republic's "oppressive" and "tyrannical" government. These people had [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] the planet [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]] and settled far from the reach of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] bureaucracy.<ref name="SotES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==The galaxy in 20,000 BBY==
The year 20,000 BBY marked the end of the Expansionist Era and the beginning of the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], an era of expansion and exploration beyond the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the then&ndash;known [[galactic community]] which was nestled along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The exploration was primarily contained to the "Wild Space" area, which later became known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="EA" /> About this time, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] was facing the domestic problems of overpopulation and a lack of trade.<ref name="CCW" /> To remedy these, the planetary government commissioned the blazing of a new hyperspace trail to connect both eastward to Coruscant and to points westward.<ref name="EA" /><ref name="CCW" /> Upon its completion, the [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]] connected Coruscant to [[Orooturoo]].<ref name="CCW" />

==Impact==
{{Quote|The Republic's boom collapsed due to internal scuffling, as the planet Alsakan attempted to usurp Coruscant as the rightful galactic capital.|From the text of ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' by [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />}}
The Galactic Republic saw massive settlement in the Expansion Region and broader areas of the Slice as the Great Manifest Period continued. The growth was fostered by government-backed, corporation-sponsored settlement. Coruscant and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] were among the most active and prosperous planets at this time, striking the ire of rival world [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]. This later became the impetus that led to the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]]. At the same time, the corporate-sponsored settlement caused planetary resources to be exploited and settlers left in poor conditions; many worlds eventually revolted.<ref name="EA" />

The goals established on Metellos to remedy its problems with trade and overcrowding were only marginally realized with the creation of the Metellos Trade Route. While the connection to Coruscant did increase some trade traffic, the largest gain was with planets westward, such as Orooturoo. At the same time, the opening of Metellos to the broader galaxy did relieve some of the overcrowding that had developed in the prior years.<ref name="CCW" />

==Notable events==
*The Galactic Republic's Great Manifest Period began.<ref name="EA" />
*Metellos attempted to establish a hyperlane connecting it with Coruscant and points westward to alleviate domestic problems. The new route stretched from Coruscant to Orooturoo.<ref name="CCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The date 20,000 BBY was first alluded to in the [[roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in [[2003]] while discussing Metellos and the creation of the Metellos Trade Route.<ref name="CCW" />

Other sources make reference to events that happened "more than twenty thousand years" before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], such as the [[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook|''Shadows of the Empire'' Sourcebook]], which discusses the [[Etti]] fleeing persecution in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and settling on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. Nevertheless, the text states that this event had happened sometime prior to 20,000 BBY, at an unidentified time.<ref name="SotES" />

The article "[[Disturbance in the Force (article)|Disturbance in the Force]]" in the magazine ''[[Challenge (magazine)|Challenge]] [[Challenge 66|66]]'' features the story of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Roni von Wasaki]] and gives their birth year as approximately 20,000 BBY. However, the magazine was released without [[Lucas Licensing]] approval, and thus is non-canon.<ref name="C66-DF">{{ChallengeCite|66|Disturbance in the Force (article)}}</ref>
